// dir: pass
// want: analyzer "file-size" declares "max_lines", nothing reads it
// want: pass Leak: core reads params outside its modeled readers
package pass

type ParamSet struct{}

func (ParamSet) Int(key string, fallback int) int { return fallback }

type Context struct{}

func (Context) Params(id string) ParamSet                             { return ParamSet{} }
func ExtensionFilter(ctx Context, id string, extra []string) []string { return extra }
func Leak(params ParamSet)                                                    { params.Int("ghost", 1) }
